Case note: O.S. No. 1494/2020
Client: Deepak Ghosh (bank manager, Lucknow)
Opposing party: Vandana Kurian
Court: Lucknow District Court
Filed on: 4 March 2020
Claim amount: ₹1,86,00,000
Issue: land dispute. The occupant claims ownership by adverse possession.
Advice given: Rebut the adverse possession claim with tax receipts showing continuous ownership.
Outcome: The adverse possession claim was dismissed.
Recommended next step: Seek possession of the land.
